entries.description: The operator's correction laws, compiled from the failure ledger — load whenever starting work, being corrected, or before a risky action. Use whenever the seat is about to act without consulting, declare done, or repeat a known failure. Pushy on purpose: read this before any task involving the operator, a deadline, or a surface the operator actually touches.
